The '''Gilded Descent Casino''' was a [[casino]] located on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] that at some point before enlisting in the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Han Solo|Han]] [[Gambling|played]] a game of [[sabacc]] at.<ref name="Imperial Cadet 2" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Gilded Descent Casino first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2018]] comic book [[Han Solo - Imperial Cadet 2|''Han Solo - Imperial Cadet'' 2]].<ref name="Imperial Cadet 2" /> The [[Gilded Descent Casino/Legends|casino]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
